Alex R.: FYI customer 'Clearwave' reported sustained 503s on dedicated pool during their morning peak, SLA at risk. Can we align on owners and short-term workaround?
Marta L.: Ack. I saw the alert. Looks like an autoscaler regression + a routing policy that started sending large batches to a small subset of pods.
Devon C.: Repro'd in staging — when seq_len spikes the pool is dropping below min-replicas due to a bug in the grace period handler. PR #4821 fixes it but needs an extra review.
Kim H.: @Devon C. linking the PR: https://git.internal/rdrw/repo/pull/4821. I can review but will be ~2h. Can we mitigate with a routing policy change in the meantime?
Marta L.: We can set per-customer cap on batch_size for Clearwave route to 4 to avoid the spike. That's a config change in routing service. I can push the change if we agree.
Alex R.: Agree on short-term cap. Who will deploy and monitor?
Marta L.: I will deploy the cap to canary (region-us-east-1) now, then roll to 100% if stable. ETA 20–30m.
Devon C.: Meanwhile, I'll queue the hotfix patch for the scaler and leave a rollback flag. PR includes this snippet to change grace logic:
```
// scaler.go
if time.Since(lastHeartbeat) > gracePeriod { // previously > gracePeriod + jitter
  // hold replicas open until pendingWork drains
}
```
Kim H.: Reviewing the code now. @Lei Z. can you watch infra for pod churn and p99 latency after Marta's config change? :eyes:
Lei Z.: On it. I'll set a short dashboard pin and a PagerDuty watch for the next 2 hours.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-451. Severity: High. Owners: Marta L., Devon C. Link: https://incidents/rdrw/INC-2026-451
Alex R.: Good. Expected timeline: Marta deploys cap in 30m -> observe 60m -> if stable, roll config cluster-wide. Devon aims to get hotfix merged in 3h and a canary rollout afterward. If hotfix delayed past 4h we escalate rollback to previous routing config.
Kim H.: Quick ask for customer comms: can someone prepare a short note for CS with ETA and mitigation steps? I can draft, Marta can send after we confirm canary.
Marta L.: I'll draft now and post to #customer-success once I see canary stabilizing.
Devon C.: If my reviewer stalls, ping me directly in thread. I have a backup reviewer (Kim) tagged in PR.
Alex R.: Owners and next steps summarized: Marta (routing cap + customer comms), Devon (scaler hotfix PR), Kim (PR review backup + monitor), Lei (infra watch). I'll check back in 45m for status. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
